title: Creamy Cashew Cool Celery Dip
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 cup raw cashews, ((soaked or boiled if not using a high-powered blender, see notes))
ldInstructionsRaw: Add everything to a blender, and blend until completely smooth and creamy, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed. This dip will get even thicker when stored in the fridge.
